event: Progressive CPO export levy of US$55-255/t takes effect (PMK 191/2020)
Domestic market obligation (20%) announced for CPO and olein exporters
DMO revoked; export levy cap raised from US$355 to US$375/t
Export ban on cooking oil and raw materials announced (Friday evening), from 28 Apr
Ban widened to include crude palm oil (late 27 Apr); ban starts 28 Apr
President announces the ban ends on 23 May
Export levy cut to zero until 31 Aug 2022
CPO export levy raised from 7.5% to 10% of the reference price (PMK 30/2025), effective 17 May
